1544131836389036032.a:
Incidentally:
Enable i386 support on a non-386 system:
sudo dpkg --add-architecture i386
sudo apt install whatever:i386

Even run ARM64 executables on AMD64?
sudo dpkg --add-architecture arm64
sudo apt install qemu-arm-static
sudo apt install whatever:arm64

Yup.
